import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = scanner.nextLine();
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        boolean usedFlag = false;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < str.length()) {
            if (i > 0 && i + 2 < str.length() && isDotSequence(str, i)) {
                result.append('.');
                i += 3;
                continue;
            }
            if (!usedFlag && i > 0 && i + 1 < str.length() && isAtSequence(str, i)) {
                result.append('@');
                i += 2;
                usedFlag = true;
                continue;
            }
            result.append(str.charAt(i));
            i++;
        }
        System.out.println(result.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static boolean isDotSequence(String str, int index) {
        return str.charAt(index) == 'd' && str.charAt(index + 1) == 'o' && str.charAt(index + 2) == 't';
    }

    private static boolean isAtSequence(String str, int index) {
        return str.charAt(index) == 'a' && str.charAt(index + 1) == 't';
    }
}
